commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: fix(agent): use bash for init script content, separate targetShell
commits.body:
The init script is sourced by bash via --init-file, so its content
(prompt config, history config, etc.) must be bash-compatible.
The targetShell parameter now controls what shell to exec into
for the interactive session.

This fixes the "setopt: command not found" error that occurred
when the init script was generated for zsh but sourced by bash.

- Add targetShell option to InitScriptOptions
- Always generate init script content for bash
- Use targetShell (defaults to detected user shell) for exec
- Update tests to explicitly pass targetShell

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
